svg.title: Shrinking support, constant integral
svg.desc: The spikes n times the indicator of (0,1/n), for n=1,4,16, have area one on fixed axes. Dashed g(x)=1/x for x>0 dominates every spike, with g(0)=0. Arrows show the curve continuing above the frame as x decreases to zero. Its integral diverges logarithmically, so this envelope does not permit DCT. The sequence is not increasing, so MCT also does not apply.
